installCommand: mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin" && curl --fail --silent --show-error --location --output /tmp/uv.tar.gz https://releases.astral.sh/github/uv/releases/download/0.11.11/uv-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz && echo 'a767848254391855c96df271e9ca8b7f72dd172d310460447853d25d907b9ae0  /tmp/uv.tar.gz' | sha256sum --check --status && tar -xzf /tmp/uv.tar.gz -C "$HOME/.local/bin" --strip-components=1 --no-same-owner && export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && uv sync --frozen && corepack enable && pnpm --dir explorer install --frozen-lockfile
